mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports valuation expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 3.5% signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST > 1100) and GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18900) indicate robust economic expansion that fuels corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through multiplicative demand effects.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1100 and GDPC1 > 18900 (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) triggers restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity that increases corporate output and profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105 (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal savings (RSAFS > 500000) signals heightened consumer confidence and spending capacity that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 500000 (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through labor demand synergy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) increases discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through policy-driven valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).
